title: Job — a structured, allow-listed remediation command queued by the server and executed by the agent
description: Jobs are DATA, never raw command strings. The server validates each job against the device's current issues, the Master Manifest allow-lists, and the software policy before queueing; the agent re-validates locally before executing. Delivery: the next queued job rides the heartbeat ack (one in flight per machine); the agent reports state transitions back on /api/job_update.

kind.description: allow-listed handler names; unknown kinds are rejected at creation and at execution

subject.description: what the job targets by name: game_id | app display_name (reported inventory entry) | content_id

arg.description: handler parameter: update_game = Steam app_id (digits only, must come from the Master Manifest allow-list); deploy_content = sha256; null otherwise

path.description: target filesystem path: update_game = install dir (from report or factory baseline); cleanup_duplicate = keep-path (all other copies for that game_id get removed)
